title: Return a stable JSON envelope for every exception
summary: Make --json failures as machine-readable as successes while retaining stderr diagnostics.
diff_sketch: Route caught CLI exceptions through one stable schema_version/status/error envelope and preserve exits 1/2/3.
risk: Additive behavior on previously plain-text JSON-mode failures.
test_plan: tests/test_cli.py pins category, message, exit code, stdout JSON, and stderr diagnostic.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Every automation failure path depends on this contract.

title: Publish deterministic CLI capabilities
summary: Let agents discover commands, nested arguments, exit meanings, environment controls, and output schemas from the binary.
diff_sketch: Add qg capabilities --json backed by parser introspection and a versioned deterministic schema.
risk: Additive read-only command; schema versioned independently.
test_plan: tests/test_cli.py verifies route completeness, required schema fields, project independence, and identical repeated bytes.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: The contract removes external-document dependency for every agent.

title: Make public help stable and recursively discoverable
summary: Render deterministic-width help with explicit command sections, nested descriptions, and no internal verb leakage.
diff_sketch: Use a stable help formatter, bounded parser builders, explicit nested command groups, and remove managed-only verbs from help choices.
risk: Help text layout changes while command parsing remains compatible.
test_plan: Recursive surface inventory must find all public nested verbs and no adapter or hook verbs; parser route test remains complete.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Help is the recovery surface for every unfamiliar command.

title: Teach the nearest valid flag or verb on mistakes
summary: Convert unknown-token errors into precise copy-pasteable corrections without auto-running potentially mutating commands.
diff_sketch: Extract the invalid token, compare it against parser-local flags and verbs, append a deterministic 'Did you mean ...?' command, and preserve exit 2.
risk: Only error text changes; execution and exit classification remain unchanged.
test_plan: Replay the 277-entry corpus and pin representative flag, verb, and no-close-match outcomes.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: 275 of 277 stress invocations currently produce useless errors.

title: Map conventional agent verbs to safe exact commands
summary: Teach test, verify, health, docs, and scan guesses as explicit command suggestions.
diff_sketch: Add a reviewed alias-to-suggestion table used only on invalid top-level verbs; never execute the alias implicitly.
risk: Suggestions are read-only diagnostics and do not broaden command authority.
test_plan: Invoke each conventional verb and assert its exact canonical command and exit 2.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: These are high-frequency first guesses for agent users.

title: Embed a paste-ready agent guide
summary: Provide robot-docs guide so a cold agent can select setup, daily, deep-review, and release workflows without external docs.
diff_sketch: Add robot-docs guide and robot-docs --json containing quick start, control loop, safety rules, and exact next commands.
test_plan: Pin required sections and copy-pasteable commands in both text and JSON modes.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Cold agents otherwise depend on repository docs and context injection.

title: Add a one-call quality triage view
summary: Collapse status, doctor findings, risk, onboarding next action, and recommended commands into one read-only response.
diff_sketch: Add triage --json with stable health, risk, latest evidence, blockers, next action, and command fields; human mode renders the same model.
risk: Read-only aggregation over existing models; no gate execution or writes.
test_plan: Validate schema with an initialized fixture and ensure suggested commands are executable parser paths.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Daily orientation currently requires several round trips.

title: Support qg help COMMAND as a first-class discovery path
summary: Accept the conventional help-first ordering in addition to COMMAND --help.
diff_sketch: Normalize help COMMAND and nested paths to the corresponding parser help without executing the command.
risk: Additive read-only alias with no project requirement.
test_plan: Pin qg help check and qg help onboarding refresh output and exit 0.

title: Make empty invocations self-describing
summary: Return human help for bare qg and the machine capabilities contract for qg --json.
diff_sketch: Recover only exact empty human and machine invocations before parsing; keep every ambiguous invocation fail-closed.
risk: Additive read-only cold-start behavior that requires no project.
test_plan: Invoke qg and qg --json without a repository and validate human help plus the versioned machine contract.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: Every cold human or agent can begin with an empty invocation.

title: Make embedded guidance rootless
summary: Let cold agents search bundled test and QA playbooks before a project is initialized.
diff_sketch: Classify guidance as a project-independent read-only handler and pin a search from an unrelated temporary directory.
risk: Removes unnecessary discovery; guidance content and project state remain unchanged.
test_plan: Run multi-word JSON guidance from a temporary non-project directory and assert clean structured results.

priority_components.blast_radius_reason: All pre-setup agents need the same bundled guidance.
